clauses.title: Minor attaining majority. From the date the minor attains majority, all transactions, standing instructions
clauses.text: and systematic registrations (SIP, STP, SWP) in the folio are suspended and the guardian may no longer operate the folio, until the major submits the change-of-status form, their own KYC and new bank details.
